identity.name: Gallows Halberd
identity.summary: A crescent axe and spear mounted on a dark long shaft.
identity.description: Costs 3 stamina per activation. Deals 15 physical damage per affordable activation. Bypasses up to 5 enemy block per activation. Warrior only: gains 1 Momentum after an affordable activation.
identity.lore: Hung above an empty scaffold after the tyrant fled.

effects.description: Costs 3 stamina per activation. Deals 15 physical damage per affordable activation. Bypasses up to 5 enemy block per activation. Warrior only: gains 1 Momentum after an affordable activation.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

synergies.description: Feeds Momentum-spending Warrior weapons; ordinary completed exchanges remain another Momentum source.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
recipes.description: Combine Marching Pike, Oathbreaker Flail, Thorn Whetstone into Gallows Halberd.
